stepTitle: James and Kathy have a rematch for their race on roller skates. Again, they race along a long, straight track, and whoever has gone the farthest after $$3$$ sec wins. Their speeds are the same as last time with James's velocity at $$f(t)=2t+5$$ ft per sec and Kathy's velocity of $$g(t)=cos\left(\frac{\pi t}{2}\right)+10$$ ft per sec. Who is going to win the race this time around?
